wz.ps.divisi.web.label: Web & apps
wz.ps.divisi.web.ngurus: Landing pages & business website, live on your own address with no hosting fees
wz.ps.tanya.web:
1. Do you already have a website?
   a) not yet, make me a landing page (recommended: one page that goes straight to ordering)
   b) yes, but I want a new one
   c) yes & I want to keep it, Dimas just looks after it & helps with content
2. Which web address?
   a) a free address for now, domain later (recommended: can go live today)
   b) I already have my own domain (write it in the other answer)
3. How do visitors order / ask? (write the WhatsApp number in the other answer)
   a) WhatsApp button (recommended: easiest & what buyers use most)
   b) Instagram DM
   c) link to a marketplace store
wz.ps.divisi.marketing.label: Ads marketing
wz.ps.divisi.marketing.ngurus: Ad reports & suggestions from exported data
wz.ps.divisi.admin.label: Admin & stock
wz.ps.divisi.admin.ngurus: Stock summaries, suggested shopping lists, expense notes
wz.ps.divisi.keuangan.label: Finance
wz.ps.divisi.keuangan.ngurus: Receipts & bank statements into a cash book, monthly P&L, bill reminders
wz.ps.sop.catat-kas: Record receipts & statements in the cash book
wz.ps.tanya.keuangan:
1. Where does most of your money come in?
   a) bank transfer (recommended: statements can be imported in one go)
   b) QR payments / e-wallet
   c) cash in store
   d) marketplace payouts
2. When should profit & loss be summarized?
   a) on the 1st of each month, for the previous month (recommended: most common & simple)
   b) every Monday, for the previous week
3. How do you usually send receipts & statements?
   a) office Drive folder, Keuangan subfolder (recommended: just snap them from your phone)
   b) paste / send in the Claude app
   c) upload to the masuk/keuangan folder on the server
wz.ps.divisi.katalog.label: Catalog & listings
wz.ps.divisi.katalog.ngurus: Product photos & info into titles, descriptions, variants for marketplaces
wz.ps.tanya.katalog:
1. Which marketplaces do you sell on? (more than one: write it in the other answer)
   a) Shopee (recommended: start with the busiest)
   b) Lazada
   c) TikTok Shop
   d) Shopee + TikTok Shop
2. Which products get listings first?
   a) best sellers (recommended: biggest impact)
   b) new products with no listing yet
   c) products whose listings get few buyers
3. How will you send product photos?
   a) office Drive folder, Katalog subfolder, one folder per product (recommended)
   b) upload to the masuk/katalog folder on the server
wz.ps.divisi.tagihan.label: Quotes & invoices
wz.ps.divisi.tagihan.ngurus: PDF quotes & invoices, receivables list, late-payment reminders
wz.ps.sop.penawaran: Price quote from a client brief
wz.ps.tanya.tagihan:
1. Business details for the letterhead & payment account? Write them in the other answer: address, contact (WhatsApp/email), account (bank, number, account name).
   a) use the business name for now, fill in the account before the first invoice (recommended: quotes can start right away)
   b) I'll fill it in with Gilang in the Claude app later
2. How long is a quote valid?
   a) 14 days (recommended)
   b) 7 days
   c) 30 days
3. Invoice due in how many days?
   a) 7 days (recommended)
   b) 14 days
   c) 3 days
wz.ps.tampilan.cozy.label: Cozy small office
wz.ps.tampilan.cozy.ket: Warm 3D cartoon style. A small shophouse: desks, round meeting room, kitchen, porch. Fits 1–4 teams.
wz.ps.tampilan.modern.label: Modern open space
wz.ps.tampilan.modern.ket: White flat illustration style. Long desks, glass meeting room, manager's room, lounge, bar.
wz.ps.tampilan.kantor.label: Big office
wz.ps.tampilan.kantor.ket: Pixel art style. Owner's room, meeting room, desks, pantry, lounge, game room. For bigger teams.
wz.ps.tampilan.papan.label: Task board only
wz.ps.tampilan.papan.ket: Task columns, no animation. The lightest option.
wz.ps.tampilan.sendiri.label: Design your own with Builder
wz.ps.tampilan.sendiri.ket: Builder makes it to your taste through chat. AI does the work, so it uses a fair bit of Claude quota (maybe several sessions). Meanwhile you get the Cozy small office template.
wz.ps.detak.malam.label: Night shift
wz.ps.detak.malam.ket: Every hour, 22:00–06:00. Overnight notifications are bundled into one, sent at 07:00. Your morning report is ready when you wake up.
wz.ps.detak.mati.label: Off for now
wz.ps.detak.mati.ket: Managers only work when you chat with them. Turn it on any time: "jadi builder, nyalain detak".
wz.ps.detak.hemat.label: Saver
wz.ps.detak.hemat.ket: Every hour, 08:00–21:00, max 12 rounds/day per manager.
wz.ps.detak.normal.label: Normal
wz.ps.detak.normal.ket: Every 30 minutes, 07:00–22:00, max 24 rounds/day per manager.

   a) now
   b) later, remind me tomorrow morning
